description: Source code for SparkResult class in Apache Spark, handling query response processing, schema management, and result iteration with Arrow integration.

classes.name: SparkResult
classes.description: Handles processing of Spark query responses, schema management, and iteration over results with Arrow support.

classes.name: SparkResultCloseable
classes.description: Manages resource cleanup for SparkResult, closing Arrow messages and responses.

methods.name: createEncoder
methods.description: Recursively updates or creates an encoder based on the schema and encoder type.

methods.name: processResponses
methods.description: Processes incoming responses, updating schema, progress, and assembling Arrow batches.

methods.name: processObservedMetrics
methods.description: Transforms observed metrics from protobuf to Scala Row format.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns total number of records in the result after processing all responses.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema of the result, processing responses if necessary.

methods.name: operationId
methods.description: Returns the operation ID, processing responses if needed.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entire result into an array of type T.

methods.name: getObservedMetrics
methods.description: Returns all observed metrics as a map.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides a non-destructive iterator over the result.

methods.name: destructiveIterator

methods.name: buildIterator
methods.description: Builds an iterator, either destructive or non-destructive, over the result.
